content_item.title: How a Solo Founder Turned Support Tickets Into a Product Roadmap

source_payload_json.abstract_idea: A fictional founder explains how repeated customer support patterns shaped a product roadmap.
source_notes: The company and founder are synthetic.
The core lesson is to listen for repeated customer pain rather than isolated feature requests.
Avoid naming real customers, revenue numbers, or proprietary support details.

creative_defaults.visual_strategy: desk, product sketches, anonymized support queue, roadmap board
